cards.card_text: Then he asks: "Incline Your ear, O LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, O LORD, and see." Listen, he says, to the words Sennacherib sent to defy the living God.
cards.verse_text: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, O LORD, and see. Listen to the words that Sennacherib has sent to defy the living God.
